title: Network Centrality Measures for Identifying Key Circuit Nodes

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Comparing structural centrality to causal importance could validate or invalidate a useful heuristic. If centrality predicts causal importance, it provides a cheap proxy for expensive patching. Moderate safety relevance through efficiency gains.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Take a known circuit, build its graph in NetworkX, compute centrality measures, compare to published causal importance rankings. Very well-bounded. Easily achievable in well under 30 hours.
